About Me

Engineering precision,
delivered at scale.

I'm a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer at BJIT with 7+ years of combined experience delivering precision CAD design, leading engineering teams, and building automation systems that make design faster and more consistent.

My expertise covers the full design lifecycle — from translating client briefs into precise 2D/3D models, to generating manufacturing-ready documentation that factories can use directly. I work fluently in SolidWorks, CATIA V6, 3DExperience, AutoCAD, and Fusion 360.

Beyond execution, I lead CAD teams of 3–5 engineers, develop automation macros to eliminate repetitive workflows, and mentor junior engineers. As a freelancer I've delivered 150+ projects — clients from Sweden to Canada trust me to get their designs right the first time.
